sara: Quick thought 3 can we expose a zero-copy streaming API in the Go SDK that behaves like an io.Reader so apps can pipe tokens directly into processors?

jason: I prototyped a Reader-returning generator before but we copied buffers at the auth/retry boundary.

priya: Auth refresh mid-stream is the hard part. If we retry we must avoid re-emitting tokens to the app.

sara: Right. Target: minimal allocations for high-volume streaming (ingest, realtime assistants). Parity with other SDKs would help DX.

jason: Sketch:
```go
type StreamReader interface {
  io.Reader
  Close() error
  Seq() int64 // last emitted seq for resume/dedupe
}
// wire frames as [seq:uint64][len:uint32][payload]
```

priya: Seq numbers are useful, but runtime must ensure idempotent frames. If we resume at seq N, server should replay deterministically.

marco: Suggest a lightweight resume handshake on the socket: client sends last-seq and server truncates/rewinds. No app buffering.

sara: How does this interact with KV/prefix caching?

priya: Badly unless we add an explicit checkpoint API: CommitCache(seq). On resume we must rollback to that checkpoint to avoid divergence.

jason: UX: Reader should return a sentinel ErrWouldRetry; higher layer calls ResumeFrom(seq). Also provide IsRetry(err) helper so io libs can handle gracefully.

priya: Backpressure note: Reader blocks. Provide both a blocking Reader and a non-blocking Pull() chan adapter for high-concurrency apps. Docs should recommend Reader for simple piping, Pull for parallel consumers.

marco: CI note: tests should stub the runtime to emit deterministic seq frames. Current flake: resume test showed duplicates (expected 150 got 300).

jason: Plan: prototype Reader + ResumeFrom + small sample app demonstrating token dedupe via Seq(); add integration test that simulates mid-stream 401 and asserts no duplicate tokens. Target draft PR by EOD Friday.

sara: Please add a README snippet explaining Reader vs Channel and sample scanner code for token-by-token processing 3 new hires get confused by replays.

priya: Also ensure ErrWouldRetry is a typed error and IsRetry(err) is available; standard io callers shouldn't break.

ci-bot: noted failing log: --- FAIL: TestResume resume_test.go:48: expected 150 tokens, got 300 (duplicate emission)

jason: I'll iterate on runtime checkpoint hooks and the resume handshake. Follow up in the PR thread. :thumbsup:
